title: Quito and Lima–Callao separate operating service from construction and future delivery
summary: Two metro projects and Quito's municipal services distinguish operating sections, tunnel excavation, maintenance, educational allocations and property regularization. Eligibility reaches 95 projects and 65 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Eighteen official Spanish sources inspected November 22: thirteen HTML bodies or scoped segments and five official indexed records after direct failure. Publication, opening, reporting, repair, card requirements and forecasts remain distinct. One contracted Line 4 branch is not the entire future line; local service examples do not create extra identities.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
